name: Omek Tannou
body:
Omek Tannou
CR 12

This shapely, brown-skinned woman with the head of a lioness is loosely wrapped in flowing robes, with her arms and legs adorned in golden bands to match the diadem on her brow.

XP 19,200
LG Large outsider (angel, extraplanar, good, lawful)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +25; Aura protective aura

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 13, flat-footed 23 (+4 Dex, +14 natural, –1 size; +4 deflection vs. evil)
hp 168 (16d10+80)
Fort +15, Ref +14, Will +11; +4 resistance vs. evil, +4 vs. poison DR 15/evil; Immune acid, cold, electricity, mind-affecting effects, petrification; Resist fire 10; SR 23

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 90 ft. (good)
Melee +2 shock battleaxe +22/+17/+12/+7 (2d6+7/×3 plus 1d6 electricity) or bite +20 (2d8+7 plus 6d8 electricity)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 16th; concentration +23)

3/day—gust of wind (DC 20), lightning bolt (DC 21)
1/day—chain lightning (DC 24), control weather

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 18, Con 21, Int 15, Wis 23, Cha 24
Base Atk +16; CMB +22 (+24 bull rush); CMD 36 (38 vs. bull rush)
Feats Cleave, Combat Casting, Flyby Attack, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Spell Focus (evocation)
Skills Acrobatics +23 (+27 to jump), Diplomacy +26, Fly +25, Knowledge (nature) +21, Knowledge (planes) +21, Perception +25, Sense Motive +25, Survival +25
Languages Auran, Celestial; telepathy 120 ft., truespeech Gear +2 shock battleaxe
SQ storm-rider

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Storm-Rider (Ex)

An omek tannou’s movement and attacks are not affected by wind and she can see and hear without difficulty through all forms of weather. She cannot be blinded, deafened, or stunned by lightning or thunder, whether natural or magical.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land or sky
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure stanard

These angels serve a warrior goddess of fertility, the sky, and weather. They serve the will of the goddess, bringing blessings of rain to the faithful and drought to those who anger their mistress. In battle against the goddess’s enemies, the omek tannou also form the front lines of her troops, leading the charge and bringing the fury of the storm against her foes.

An omek tannou is typically assigned a region to oversee and is the one who will regularly respond to the planting ritual of the faithful in that region and carry out the goddess’s commands in that area. A particular omek tannou may develop protective feelings for the faithful people of the region, responding directly to any attacks or calamities that befall them.

The faithful of the goddess perform an elaborate ceremony after the planting season, with ritual costumes and dancing, to show their devotion. This ritual, named for the omek tannou, is done in the hopes of summoning one of the servants of the goddess to bless their community with rainfall and ensure a good crop for the coming harvest.
